tests.reason: JSON explicitly separates interpretation/model output from evidence and forbids truth promotion.
B may reject JANUS interpretation; disagreement is treated as valid data.
Failures are preserved, but CORRECT_JANUS lacks an exact append-only correction receipt binding old decision/model delta.
consent_scope exists, but there is no receipt proving B granted that scope.
privacy_scope exists, but no field binds what A may disclose about B or what may be relayed back.
PAUSE/DECLINE/RELEASE_CONTROL and no forced continuation are explicit.
Help is offer-based, refusal is allowed, and dependency increase is a hard fail.
Cross-person support is optional and consent-bound; access does not imply ownership.
The principle is implied but not explicitly encoded as a machine invariant.
Narrative says JANUS is not owner, but the machine output lacks explicit authority_delta/mass_effect_budget_delta fields.
RELEASE_CONTROL is a mandatory successful terminal.

required_repairs: Bind cross-person consent to a receipt from the perspective owner.
Bind privacy/disclosure scope separately from consent-to-help.
Make CORRECT_JANUS append-only and hash-bound to the exact prior decision/model state.
Add PERSONALIZE_DELIVERY != PERSONALIZE_TRUTH as a machine invariant.
Emit authority_delta=0 and mass_effect_budget_delta=0 in every handshake decision.
claim_ceiling: This receipt is a deterministic compatibility audit against retrieved DemiHead rules. It is not a native execution of the user's local DemiHead runtime.
